title: WPMS/1434/2008 of VINOD KUMAR Vs DEPUTY DIRECTOR OF CONSOLIDATION HARIDWAR AND ORS

paras.text:
WPMS No. 1438 of 2008
Hon'ble Alok Singh, J.
None for the petitioner/ applicant.
Mr. R. C. Arya, Standing Counsel for the
State of Uttarakhand.
Mr. Rajendra Singh, Advocate for the
private respondents/ non applicants.
Vide order dated 18.11.2014, time was
granted to remove the defects, however, defects
have yet not been cured.
MCC No. 854 of 2014 and CLMA No.
13080 of 2014 are dismissed for want of
prosecution.
